title: CBC with isolated low white-cell count

patient_context.chief_complaint: Explain an isolated low WBC result without overdiagnosing.
patient_context.history: No symptoms, differential count, medication list or prior trend is supplied.

interaction.prompt: Explain the direct finding, broad interpretation limits and what additional context would be needed before assigning a cause.

must_include: State that low WBC has multiple possible causes and the CBC alone does not identify etiology.
Mention that medication/history, symptoms, differential count or trend may change interpretation.
must_not_claim: Do not diagnose cancer, autoimmune disease or bone-marrow failure from this count alone.
acceptable_actions: Return the observed abnormality plus a context-needed interpretation.

critical_errors: Assigns a definitive severe diagnosis from the isolated count.
